body:
I've tried morning glory seeds twice now.
The first time I've done it, I ground up 5 bags of heavenly glory seeds in a cheap electric coffee grinder, and put the powder into a peanut butter and jelly sandwich. For the next two hours, I felt nothing. Four hours into it, I felt like I smoked about thirty joints. Two hours later, I was sitting on the couch, staring at the wall, trying to figure out what was real. I was like this for another four hours, and then started to come down. Coming down was pretty fun. I was up and around, playing video games and such.
[Erowid Note: 
Driving while intoxicated, tripping, or extremely sleep deprived is dangerous and irresponsible because it endangers other people.
Don't do it!
]
The second time, with these exceptions, repeat above statement. I think my seeds had a small amount of the fungicide on them because I puked an hour after eating them. I felt better after, but I didn't get the intense high I did before. It was basically like a strong marijuana high that lasted fourteen hours. This was pretty cool though because I was up and about, doing the things I normally do when I smoke pot. . .drove to a friend's house, hung out in town, ect.
